# Termux-Train Full Technical Specification (v2.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Unified Multimodal On-Device Deep Learning & LoRA Training Framework for Android Termux with 6-Modality Adapters (LLM, Diffusion, VLM, STT, TTS, BitNet), GPU Slicing, and 44GB Disaggregated Cluster Virtual RAM Pooling
Termux-Train v2.0.0 delivers a dependency-free C-vectorized DAG Autograd engine, 6-Modality target-aware LoRA/DoRA training (LLM, Image Diffusion, Vision VLM, Whisper STT, TTS, BitNet 1.58-bit), Mali/Adreno GPU Slicing, 300MB Guard-Band memory protection, and 44GB disaggregated cluster virtual RAM pooling across heterogeneous mobile fleets.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-train
- Command: pip install termux-train
# or via npm:
npm install -g termux-train
# or standalone bootstrap:
bash <(curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uno-km/termux-train/main/install.sh)

- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-train
